title: Tiered Tray Decor
text: Tiered Tray Decor. Tiered trays are a fun way to decorate for the holidays and seasons. This is a good set of items for St. Patrick's Day and the month of March. There is a good variety of pieces. The quality is okay. I thought that the ink printing could be a little better. I have included a picture of one where the ink wasn't full coverage and left speckles. These do look mass produced. All the wood blocks are flat and 2 dimensional.
